description: Gate 'square_norm' with HARD signs: hard +-1 signs -> integer ts; map ts in [-NAP,NAP] to [0,1] via (ts/(2*NAP)+0.5) (fraction of matching bits), SQUARE, then NORMALIZE g=g0^2/Sum (Σ=1). Normalized polynomial Hamming-similarity kernel -- a non-exponential analogue of softmax (which is the normalized EXP-hamming kernel). Tests whether quadratic peaking + normalization matches softmax-hard without the exp temperature trap. vs softmax-hard 1.5437, relu_norm-hard 1.6621, layernorm-hard 1.6401, argmax 1.4962, softmax-soft 1.4806.
